in_hebrew.name: Rayner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rayner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old French name Renaud, meaning 'recommended for rulership'. In legends, Rayner (also known as Reynard) is a cunning fox who rules over the forest.

in_greek.name: Rayner
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Reynard's ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Rayner είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old French name Renaud, meaning 'recommended for rulership'. In legends, Rayner (also known as Reynard) is a cunning fox who rules over the forest.

in_latin.name: Rayner
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Reynard's ruler
in_latin.long_meaning: Rayner est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old French name Renaud, meaning 'recommended for rulership'. In legends, Rayner (also known as Reynard) is a cunning fox who rules over the forest.
